claim: For the fixed finite sparse paired-edge family in REPORT.txt, with fixed k_ji >= 1 and every rate in a compact interval bounded strictly above zero and below infinity, there are a single class-relative V and constants C,c>0, independent of the rate vector and isolated-substrate label z, such that L_theta V <= C-cV on every class Gamma_z.
quantifiers: Fix finite J,I,E and all k_ji. Then for every compact positive rate box Theta there exist R>1 rational, K finite, C<infinity, c>0, such that for every theta in Theta, z in N_0^(I_0), and variable state (a,b_+), the inequality holds with V=A+sum_(i in I_+) R^(b_i)(1+h_i(a))+K 1_(A=0).
proof_location: REPORT.txt, sections COMMON GEOMETRIC DRIFT and PHYSICAL-TIME AND STATIONARY CONSEQUENCES.
evidence: Existing exact rational sparse generator checker passes on 4096 fixture states; finite formula check only.
falsifier_or_review_gate: Independent review of the high-edge allocation that simultaneously pays low-edge catalyst contributions, support-switch surcharges, and residual coercivity.

claim: Under the same fixed finite family and positive compact rate box, every Gamma_z is nonexplosive, irreducible and positive recurrent. Its unique invariant law has a common V-moment bound; active substrates have common exponential moments, catalysts have a common first moment, and the class semigroups are V-geometrically mixing with common constants over theta and z.
quantifiers: There exist M_0,M',gamma>0 such that sup_(theta,z) pi_(theta,z)(V)<=M_0 and ||P_t^(theta,z)(x,.)-pi_(theta,z)||_V <= M' V(x) exp(-gamma t) for all t>=0 and all states x in Gamma_z.
proof_location: REPORT.txt, sections PHYSICAL-TIME AND STATIONARY CONSEQUENCES and V-GEOMETRIC MIXING.
limits: The generic V is linear in catalyst counts, so it yields no catalyst exponential moment. The mixing prefactor depends on V(x); there is no uniform mixing time over all unbounded initial states.

claim: Uniform tightness or any positive exponential-moment bound for all full-state class invariant laws over infinitely many isolated-substrate labels does not follow and is false for this family.
counterexample: E=empty, one catalyst with 0<->A, one inert B. For each z, Gamma_z={(a,z):a>=0} has invariant Pois(alpha/delta) tensor delta_z. For any finite set F, a sufficiently large z makes pi_z(F)=0; E_pi_z exp(eta B)=exp(eta z) is unbounded for eta>0.
proof_location: REPORT.txt, section ISOLATED-CLASS OBSTRUCTION TO FULL-STATE UNIFORMITY.

claim: Within this sparse family, complex balance is equivalent to c_j=alpha_j/delta_j, c_i=p_ji/q_ji, and c_j^(k_ji)=u_ji/v_ji on every edge, with the substrate ratios consistent across each N(i). For these rates, the invariant law in Gamma_z is the independent active-coordinate product-Poisson law tensor delta_z.
proof_location: REPORT.txt, section COMPLEX-BALANCED SUBFAMILY: EXACT LAWS.
limits: Product form applies only to the complex-balanced parameter subset. The sparse geometric-drift candidate is intended to cover the whole compact positive rate box.
